# toml-test skip-list for TOML 1.0.0
#
# Tests skipped because v4.2.0 has known limitations.
# Each removal from this file is progress toward v5.0.0, where
# the goal is an empty skip-list.
#
# Categories of current gaps:
#   - Date/time: parser accepts omitted seconds, which TOML 1.0 forbids.
#   - Control characters in strings/comments: lexer accepts some forbidden control bytes.
#   - Multiline string quote-edge cases.
#
# Format: one toml-test name per line (no extension), comments start with '#'.
